motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The one easing: line draws, rise-in, action hover.

motion.name: line-draw-stagger
motion.value: outline 0 / 0.08 / 0.16 / 0.24s, service lines 0.32s, centre line 0.44s, net 0.56s

motion.name: serve
motion.value: ball animateMotion along the serve path, begin 1.05s, dur 0.95s, keySplines 0.3 0.1 0.35 1, fill freeze; radius 15 -> 25.5 -> 15 (keyTimes 0;0.45;1); trail mask draws over the same 0.95s
motion.purpose: The ball is served once across the net and stays.

motion.name: target-ring
motion.value: rise-in 0.9s ease-out-expo at 1.95s: from opacity 0, translateY(14px), blur(6px)

motion.name: in-view-draw
motion.value: IntersectionObserver threshold 0.15, disconnects after first hit; pending fallback draws after 6s
motion.purpose: Mini courts draw once when seen; lines are never lost.

motion.name: action-hover
motion.value: 300ms ease-out-expo on background, color, box-shadow, transform; arrow nudges 2px up-right; active translateY(1px)

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no line draw (dashoffset 0), no rise-in, no SMIL; ball rendered at rest on target; scroll-behavior auto

narrative.overview:
The page is a padel court seen from above. Its ground is the drenched blue of the playing surface, its structure is painted white line work drawn to the real 10 × 20 m geometry, and everything outside the court sits in a deep navy surround, the way the floor around a court reads at night. Content is placed into the court's own zones (back zones, service boxes, the net) rather than into cards, and later sections keep the same grammar: thick painted rules divide, short line dashes mark lists, and the surface alternates between surround and court blue as the visitor walks "on" and "off" court.

The voice is sign-painted and athletic: a condensed, very heavy uppercase display face for names, headings, prices and scores; a sturdy grotesque for reading. Density is low and confident. One yellow, the colour of the ball, is the only warm thing on the page and it only appears where the ball would: the actions, the served ball, the ball mark, and interactive state.

Motion is a single sporting gesture: on load the court lines draw themselves in play order, the net drops in, then the ball is served once across the net into the opposite service box and stays there. Nothing loops.
keyCharacteristics: Court blue drench on a navy surround; no light theme (`color-scheme: dark`).
White line work at true court proportions; lines, not boxes.
Ball yellow is rare and always means "the ball" or "act here".
Condensed black-weight uppercase display over a plain, readable grotesque.
Square everything, except the pill-shaped actions.
Flat; depth comes from surface change, not shadow.

rules.name: The Only-The-Ball Rule
rules.body: Ball yellow appears only where the ball is: actions, the served ball, the ball mark, and focus/selection/caret/active-field state. Never as a heading colour, a section fill, a decorative accent or a highlight on facts.

rules.name: The On-Court / Off-Court Rule
rules.body: A section is either on court (court blue fill) or off court (navy surround). There is no third surface colour for sections; raised surround is only for empty media slots.

rules.name: The Painted-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that matters (price, score, court number) is set in the display face with tabular numerals. Body copy never carries the key figure alone.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone; no eyebrow labels above them. Uppercase tracked small text is reserved for form labels and captions under objects.

rules.name: The Painted-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never float. New elements get structure from a line, not from a shadow.

rules.name: The Lines-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: Content is framed by lines (a top rule, a divider, a court zone), never by a filled, padded, rounded card. A 2px frame is reserved for media (photo, map) where the frame is the court line around a picture.

dos: **Do** place hero content into court zones at the court's real proportions (15.25 / 34.75 / 34.75 / 15.25).
**Do** use landscape court from 1024px and the portrait court below it, so the whole court is the first screen.
**Do** frame and divide with 2px Court Line White rules, 1px hairlines at 10–30%, and 12 × 2px dashes for lists.
**Do** keep Ball Yellow for actions, the served ball, the ball mark and interactive state.
**Do** set prices, scores and court numbers in the display face with tabular numerals.
**Do** alternate on-court (court blue) and off-court (navy) sections.
**Do** keep motion to one gesture: lines draw, the ball is served once, then stillness; honour reduced motion with the finished state.
donts: **Don't** use rounded, filled or shadowed cards; lines, not boxes.
**Don't** round anything except actions (pills) and the ball itself.
**Don't** use Ball Yellow for headings, fills, highlights or decoration.
**Don't** add a third section surface colour or a light theme.
**Don't** paint the nav on the court; the nav belongs to the surround.
**Don't** add shadows beyond the ball lift and the hero court slab.
**Don't** loop or repeat the serve, or animate lines on every scroll.
